title: Homotopy equivalent two-term complexes: A_1 + B_0 is isomorphic to B_1 + A_0
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $d_A:A_1\to A_0$ and $d_B:B_1\to B_0$ be homomorphisms of $R$-modules. Suppose given $R$-linear maps $\varphi_i:A_i\to B_i$ and $\psi_i:B_i\to A_i$ ($i=0,1$) with $d_B\circ\varphi_1=\varphi_0\circ d_A$ and $d_A\circ\psi_1=\psi_0\circ d_B$, and $R$-linear maps $h:A_0\to A_1$ and $h':B_0\to B_1$ with $$\mathrm{id}_{A_1}-\psi_1\circ\varphi_1=h\circ d_A,\quad\mathrm{id}_{A_0}-\psi_0\circ\varphi_0=d_A\circ h,\quad\mathrm{id}_{B_1}-\varphi_1\circ\psi_1=h'\circ d_B,\quad\mathrm{id}_{B_0}-\varphi_0\circ\psi_0=d_B\circ h'.$$ Then $A_1\oplus B_0\cong B_1\oplus A_0$ as $R$-modules.
